note: This folder is mostly hand-maintained static content (README, RUN.md, index.html, run.sh, process/, schemas/, config/, examples/, assets/, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHANGELOG.md, wiki/, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, hooks/hooks.json, commands/). assets/ holds site screenshots (e.g. site-hero.png) used by README.md/wiki pages -- distinct from examples/, which stays strictly real report-output examples, nothing else. hooks/hooks.json is a byte-identical copy of bar_hook::plugin_hooks_json()'s output, drift-guarded by bar-hook/tests/plugin_drift.rs in the private working repo -- not hand-edited here, but not generated by public-export.sh either. Only CRATES.md is generated by scripts/public-export.sh, from the private working repo's crate manifests. Requires human approval (ADR-016) before this folder is pushed to a real GitHub remote.
